title: Temperature Modulation of the DBDp53 Structure as Monitored by Static and Time-Resolved Fluorescence Combined with Molecular Dynamics Simulations.
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文通过静态/时间分辨荧光结合MD模拟研究p53 DNA结合域在不同温度下的结构动态与异质性，虽未直接建模TF-DNA互作，但聚焦p53 DBD（TF-DNA结合核心域）构象变化并讨论其对DNA结合能力的调控，方法可迁移至TF-DNA互作机制研究。
abstract: Trp146 of the p53 DNA-binding domain (DBD) was investigated by static and time-resolved fluorescence combined with molecular dynamics (MD) simulations at different temperatures (25, 30, 37, and 45  degrees C). Static emission spectra exhibit an intensity maximum at 30  degrees C without any substantial peak shift, while the time-resolved fluorescence displays a peculiar stretched exponential decay, indicative of a structural disorder, at all of the investigated temperatures. The stretched exponential parameter was found to increase at 37  degrees C. An analysis of the MD simulation trajectories evidenced the occurrence of jumps in the temporal evolution of the distances between Trp146 and residues Arg110, Asp228, Cys229, and Gln144, which are mainly responsible for Trp146 fluorescence quenching. The times that these quenchers spend close to or far from Trp146 can provide an explanation for the static fluorescence behavior. Further essential dynamics analysis of the MD trajectories indicates a significant restriction of protein global motions above 37  degrees C. These results are consistent with a decrease in the structural heterogeneity of DBD as the temperature increases. The results are also discussed in view of understanding how temperature can modulate the p53 capability to binding partners, including DNA.
abstract_zh: 通过静态与时间分辨荧光技术，结合不同温度（25、30、37和45摄氏度）下的分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）模拟，对p53 DNA结合域（DBD）中的Trp146进行了研究。静态发射光谱在30摄氏度时表现出强度最大值，且无明显峰位移动，而时间分辨荧光在所有研究温度下均显示出奇特的拉伸指数衰减，表明存在结构无序性。拉伸指数参数在37摄氏度时增加。对MD模拟轨迹的分析揭示了Trp146与残基Arg110、Asp228、Cys229和Gln144之间距离的时间演化中出现跳跃，这些残基主要负责Trp146的荧光猝灭。这些猝灭剂靠近或远离Trp146的时间可以解释静态荧光行为。对MD轨迹的进一步本质动力学分析表明，在37摄氏度以上，蛋白质整体运动受到显著限制。这些结果与随着温度升高DBD结构异质性降低的现象一致。此外，讨论这些结果有助于理解温度如何调节p53与包括DNA在内的结合伙伴的能力。
